headline: SH Kelkar and Company issues notice for postal ballot to shareholders
hook: Postal ballot notice sent to shareholders
summary: S H Kelkar and Company Limited has informed the stock exchange regarding the issuance of a notice for a postal ballot to its shareholders. The filing is a procedural corporate communication required for resolutions. Shareholders will cast their votes remotely on proposed company matters. Retail investors should note this is standard governance procedure and does not immediately impact share value.
whats_next: Voting results of the postal ballot

headline: S H Kelkar and Company receives cautionary letters from BSE and NSE
